notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a full replication manuscript with supplementary material, titled Revisiting “Goals as Reference Points”: Replication and extensions of Heath et al. (1999), by Irene Nga Yu Au and Gilad Feldman. Title and authors match the neutral replication reference; abstract and open-science section identify https://osf.io/wmqtb/. It is an empirical primary report, with methods, final-sample results, discussion, references and supplement. The supplied 2024 citation date/version is not independently established in the text. No PDF was supplied; no render was possible. Only assigned replication fields were evaluated; original and unassigned numeric fields are placeholders. Target ambiguous for a single numeric effect: description includes both perceived progress (Problem 9 part 2) and commitment at end (part 3), with initial commitment (part 1) as contextual comparison. Table 10 prints part 2 h=0.60, chi-square=146.63, p<.001; part 3 h=0.25, chi-square=25.08, p<.001; context part 1 h=-0.18, chi-square=10.86, p<.001. All parts explicitly use 377 participants after validation exclusions (497 initial). The common N is recorded only as candidate evidence, not promoted to a matched numeric extraction while the coefficient correspondence is unresolved. No arithmetic or metric conversion performed. Reported success is separately extracted at the described combined Problem 9 scope: authors say all three parts briefly followed the original, with the two later effects weaker and inconsistent in magnitude. This does not establish a unique coefficient target.
